headline: Six Fronts Surge as Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last dispatch the war has sharpened on six corridors. Weathered Expanse remains the bloodiest theater, adding 12,656 Colonial and 18,558 Warden dead in the past 24 hours with 36 ownership changes, the most recent minutes ago. Callahans Passage follows with 13,710 Colonial and 14,735 Warden losses and 13 base swaps, while Stlican Shelf records 3,564 Colonial and 4,294 Warden casualties across 27 exchanges. Nevish Line shows 7,121 Colonial and 7,486 Warden dead with 17 changes, Palantine Berm adds 609 Colonial and 616 Warden dead over 19 flips, and Kuura Strand contributes 1,078 Colonial and 1,072 Warden losses amid 14 events. Hourly casualty trends are accelerating on Callahans and Kuura, cooling on Weathered, Stlican and Nevish, while enlistments surge on Palantine and Kuura. The remaining sectors stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity.
